sketches.mechanism: A mutable reference cannot coexist with any other reference — the borrow checker enforces exclusive access
sketches.resonance: Intimacy demands that no one else is looking; the language makes loneliness the price of being truly known.

sketches.mechanism: A goroutine sending on a channel with no receiver blocks forever, and a deferred close runs only when the function returns
sketches.resonance: A message sent to no one becomes an eternal waiting — the speaker is suspended, not crashed, just permanently unheard.

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type indicates a function that cannot produce a value — it must throw or loop infinitely
sketches.resonance: Some promises, by their very type signature, guarantee they will never be fulfilled.
